name: Klannoc Macleod
summary: On Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod puts warriors to the test. The human warrior welcomes fighters from both the Alliance and the Horde who seek mastery of combat stances. Those who earn his respect are sent inland to face greater trials of strength.

sections.title: The Master of Fray Island
sections.body: Klannoc Macleod puts seasoned fighters through their paces on Fray Island, off the Merchant Coast in the Barrens. Though human, he leaves Alliance and Horde quarrels aside. He judges each contender by grit, blade work, and resolve under fire.

sections.title: The Affray
sections.body: Klannoc Macleod's trial on Fray Island is called the Affray. Contenders climb onto raised iron grating and face relentless waves of eager brawlers as he watches. Those who endure the onslaught and defeat his chosen champion earn his approval and prove they have the temperament for berserker training.

faq.answer: Klannoc Macleod trains warriors and tests their limits on Fray Island off the Barrens coast. Fighters come to him to prove themselves and learn new techniques.

faq.q: Where can I find Klannoc Macleod?
faq.answer: You can find Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island, a rocky isle off the eastern Barrens coast, southeast of the Merchant Coast and Ratchet. Swim across open water to reach his camp.

faq.q: Why does a human talk to Horde players on Fray Island?
faq.answer: Klannoc Macleod keeps apart from the Alliance and Horde conflict. He judges contenders by their martial discipline and warrior's resolve, and tests those who arrive with a proper recommendation.

The Affray is an endurance trial on Fray Island. You stand on Klannoc's combat platform and defeat waves of challengers, ending with a fight against Big Will, to prove your ferocity for advanced warrior techniques.

faq.q: Why send warriors to Klannoc Macleod?
faq.answer: Warrior trainers across Azeroth send their most promising students to Klannoc Macleod for a trial of martial fortitude. The trial prepares you for the fierce focus of the Berserker Stance.

faq.q: Who does Klannoc send you to after the Affray?
faq.answer: After you prove yourself in the Affray, Klannoc Macleod sends you north to the Alterac Mountains, near Tarren Mill, to seek guidance from Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face Klannoc Macleod's test of endurance and ferocity in the Affray before he guides you toward the Berserker Stance.
As a Horde fighter, you can seek trial and honor with Klannoc Macleod, who sets faction rivalries aside on his island.
As an Alliance warrior, you must travel far into the waters off the Barrens coast to find Klannoc Macleod and prove your combat readiness on Fray Island.
